text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 fired — p99 latency > 1.8s in eu-west-1 for redwood-inference.prod (15m window). Dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/alerts/INC12345. Pager: @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: Ack — I'm on it. Pulling up traces and SLO heatmap.

alice_oncall: p95 looks fine, p99 jumped to ~2.3s on /generate. Traffic concentrated on model: redwood-v2, route tag=prod-eu. KV cache miss rate up ~42% in the tail.

ben_sre: I see increased CPU on sidecars and a few GC spikes around the same time. Any recent config/deploys?

maya_pm: No deploys in eu-west-1 in the last hour from release pipeline. CS is getting some pings.

chris_reliability: Quick mitigation suggestion: enable regional fallback to a smaller variant (redwood-v2-small) for eu-west for 30m and lower max_tokens for high-throughput routes. Also trigger KV cache warmup for hot prefixes.

alice_oncall: Applying fallback policy now. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/generate/policy -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"fallback_model":"redwood-v2-small","duration":"30m","reason":"p99 spike eu-west"}'```

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Route policy change accepted and propagated to 3 load balancers. Propagation ETA ~45s.

alice_oncall: Additionally throttling internal batchers to reduce noisy background traffic: ```kubectl scale deployment batch-worker --replicas=0 --namespace=prod-eu```

ben_sre: I'll revert the batch_size tweak we pushed to one of the inference pods to test correlation — rolling back on a canary node.

maya_pm: Customer impact: ~12 accounts reporting elevated latency (no 5xxs). SLO burn estimated ~11% for the 15m window. CS has a templated blurb ready.

alice_oncall: After fallback and throttles p99 trending down to ~1.05s (from 2.3s). Still above baseline but much improved. Keeping watch, collecting traces and KV hit metrics.

chris_reliability: Good. If p99 < 1.2s we can avoid PD escalation. Note: add an annotation to the incident about the KV miss spike + sidecar GC correlation.

alice_oncall: Will do. Planning handoff: I can stay on for ~20m. If stable, I'll handoff to ben_sre at 1743214389. @zach_support please hold customer-facing messages until we confirm stabilization. :thumbsup:

zach_support: Acknowledged. Draft to customers: "We're aware of increased latency in eu-west; temporary fallback applied and our engineers are mitigating. We'll update in 20 minutes or as we have more info."

incident-bot: Incidentbot: PagerDuty INC12345 still open — next automatic check-in in 10m.

alice_oncall: Logging timeline and snapshots to the incident ticket. If anyone sees the p99 climb again, post trace id or span id here.

ben_sre: Noted. Preparing a short runbook snippet if needed: ```- enable fallback
- throttle batchers
- warm KV for top prefixes
- scale inference pool up if p99 persists
- collect heap/GC profiles from sidecars```

maya_pm: I'll coordinate customer comms post-handoff. Keep me posted.

alice_oncall: Thanks team — monitoring. I'll post handoff when I leave.
